entries.note: The tracker's cargo status once the receiving terminal has issued the cargo.
The page's row "Дата сдачи груза": the day the sender handed the cargo in at the departure terminal.
The page's row of that name, from the record's date of arrival at the receiving terminal; the cargo waits there for collection or for delivery to an address.
The page's row "Дата выдачи груза", which reads "Не выдан" until the receiving terminal issues the cargo.
